hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r file; case "$file" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.scss) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --log-level warn "$file" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
